engine_detail: ISO 9660 CD: root SETUP.EXE (PE32, 17 KiB launcher) and AUTORUN.EXE (PE32, 53 MB Blizzard installer: DiabloInstall, MPQ reader, "Diablo shareware installation complete!", Diablo Uninstaller); DIRECTX2/ and DIRECTX3/ redistributables with DXSETUP.EXE + DSETUP.DLL.

expected.reason: no reference installation on a qualified system yet (f5-02B/15B); the lead pins files, registry, links, restart and uninstall residue from the QEMU installers tier

notes: AUTORUN.EXE creates a worker thread (W32_THREAD) which the single-threaded H1 adapter cannot serve. The dxsetup variant exercises the DXSETUP.EXE interception of sdk/win32/ldr/installer.c (requirement 2).
